class.name: Terrain3DTextureCache
class.description: Contains one lossless RGBA8 master or one cooked GPU variant of the unified terrain channel layout. Albedo/height and normal-XY/roughness/metallic are required; emission/AO is optional. Platform variants must be encoded from the lossless master. External .res files can be shared by layers with identical source signatures. Runtime exports reference only their selected cooked variant.

method.name: encode
method.description: Returns a cache in the requested format without modifying this resource. Encoding is editor-only and requires an RGBA8 master. Decoding a cooked cache to RGBA8 is available at runtime when the engine includes its decoder.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Checks the layout version, signature, image count, formats, mipmaps and matching dimensions. A positive size also checks the requested square resolution.

method.name: save_external
method.description: Saves a binary .res cache inside the project using lossless resource compression, a temporary file and rename. Registers its UID against the final path.
